item.title: CISA tweaks cyber incident form to spot attacks that might be linked
item.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has updated its online incident reporting form to help analysts spot when attacks on different organizations may be part of the same campaign. The revised questionnaire asks more specific questions and removes duplicate ones. The form asks whether an incident involved malware, attempts to trick people, hacking techniques, or an insider threat. It also uses terms from MITRE ATT&CK, a catalog of attacker techniques. item.title: Formbook Targets European Manufacturing and Technology Businesses with Localized Order Lures
item.description: European businesses, particularly in the UK and Italy, face malware campaigns that exploit routine business correspondence. A recent Formbook (now also known as XLoader) campaign uses localized order and procurement lures to deliver an information stealer. Manufacturing and technology companies are especially exposed because employees regularly handle purchase orders, supplier documents, and payment requests.
